aggregation: Equal weight per retained row; both chains pooled; repeated states retained; inherited prefix included once

best_sample.selection: Maximum sum of stored LF + Planck_tau + McGreer_xHI log likelihoods, not marginal medians

lf.missing_value_policy: Nonfinite native LF bins are null, never zero; plotting leaves gaps.

xi_history.definition: 1 - volume-mean neutral hydrogen fraction; not free-electron fraction
